title: Signature Plate Continuity
description: Four reference-linked plated editorials establishing a restaurant-grade signature-dish language.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the lens height, linen palette, tabletop restraint, and plating discipline. Images 02-04 preserve that same editorial dining-room system while rotating the hero dish, sauce choreography, and garnish architecture.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-chef-table-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for the remaining series images. Queue may run the dependent variations concurrently after the reference is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
